info.title: LC Management API
info.description: LC Management System API - Complete system for managing contracts, buyers, orders, and shipments. Includes contract management, order processing with cost tracking, shipment tracking with summary statistics, and comprehensive reporting capabilities.

get.description: Get detailed information about a specific Master LC

put.description: Update Master LC (only in draft status)

delete.description: Delete Master LC (only in draft status)

put.description: Importer applies for LC after agreeing on contract. Transitions from draft to applied.
Issuing bank issues LC. Transitions from applied to issued_by_issuing_bank.
Advising bank verifies LC. Transitions from issued_by_issuing_bank to verified_by_advising_bank.
Record goods shipment. Transitions from verified_by_advising_bank to goods_shipped.
Record document receipt from exporter. Transitions from goods_shipped to documents_received.
Forward documents to issuing bank. Transitions from documents_received to documents_forwarded.
Issuing bank verifies documents. Transitions from documents_forwarded to documents_verified.
Final activation of LC. Transitions from documents_verified to active.
Reject LC at any workflow stage. Transitions to rejected status.
